Jobbeschreibung
Recruiter (m/w/d)
Du bist ehrgeizig, smart und willst nicht jahrelang warten, bis man dir Verantwortung gibt? Dann lies weiter.
Bei den großen Personaldienstleistern lernst du erst monatelang Recruiting, bevor du überhaupt an den Vertrieb darfst. Bei uns nicht. Als Recruiter (m/w/d) übernimmst du von Anfang an den kompletten Zyklus: Du gewinnst Kunden, berätst sie strategisch – und setzt die Recruiting-Projekte anschließend selbst um. Eine Rolle, doppelte Kompetenz, volle Verantwortung für deinen Erfolg.
Wir sind eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mitten in Bielefeld und helfen Unternehmen, ihre Arbeitgebermarke zu stärken und planbar qualifizierte Talente zu gewinnen – mit datenbasiertem Recruiting und strukturiertem Vertrieb. Und wir arbeiten in einem Markt, der durch Fachkräftemangel und demografischen Wandel jedes Jahr weiter wächst.

s.h: Profitiere als Recruiter (m/w/d) von unseren Benefits
s.t:
Attraktives Fixgehalt + ungedeckelte Bonuszahlungen : Deine Leistung entscheidet, was am Monatsende auf deinem Konto landet – nach oben offen.
Unbefristete Festanstellung : Wir bauen langfristig auf dich – Zukunftssicherheit in einer Branche, die durch die Digitalisierung und den Fachkräftemangel stetig wächst.
Echte 360°-Entwicklung : Du baust dir Kompetenz in Vertrieb UND Recruiting auf – das Profil, das im Markt am gefragtesten ist. Klarer Entwicklungspfad: Recruiter → Junior Consultant → Senior Consultant.
Strukturiertes Onboarding & Coaching : Umfassende Einarbeitung, professionelle Schulungen in Recruiting, Beratung und Vertrieb sowie regelmäßige Feedback-Sessions
Premium - Arbeitsplatz : Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman Miller-Stühle, Apple-Technik (MacBook Air/Pro, iMac) – mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Gesundheit im Fokus : Premium-Fitnessvertrag bei einem Studio deiner Wahl.
Top - Versorgung im Office : Faema E61-Siebträgermaschine mit Julius Meinl-Kaffee, hochwertige Tees und flexibles Lunch-System von Meyer Menü
Teamkultur auf Augenhöhe : Kollegiale, leistungsorientierte Atmosphäre mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung – deine Ideen werden gehört und umgesetzt.

Du kontaktierst aktiv potenzielle Neukunden per Telefon und Direktansprache und weckst Interesse an unseren digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen.
Du analysierst die Recruiting-Herausforderungen der Unternehmen, identifizierst konkreten Handlungsbedarf und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Strategien.
Du präsentierst deine Lösungen überzeugend und begleitest den Prozess bis zum Abschluss.

Nach Vertragsabschluss steuerst du das Projekt eigenständig weiter – von der Kampagnenplanung bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung.
Du koordinierst eingehende Bewerbungen, qualifizierst Kandidaten vor und sorgst für eine professionelle Candidate Experience.

Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten sauber im CRM, behältst deine Pipeline im Blick und arbeitest zielorientiert auf deine KPIs hin.
Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung zusammen und bringst Ideen zur Optimierung unserer Prozesse ein.
Das bringst du idealerweise mit
Vertriebsaffinität: Du hast Freude an Akquise und willst aktiv neue Kunden gewinnen – am Telefon, per Video-Call oder persönlich.
Beratungsverständnis: Du erkennst Potenziale, stellst die richtigen Fragen und präsentierst Lösungen strukturiert.
Menschenkenntnis: Du verstehst sowohl die Unternehmens- als auch die Bewerberperspektive.
Eigeninitiative & Leistungswille : Du arbeitest selbstständig, bleibst auch nach einem "Nein" am Ball und willst überdurchschnittliche Ergebnisse erzielen.
Wichtig : Ob Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg mit Vertriebserfahrung – uns interessiert nicht dein Lebenslauf, sondern dein Hunger. Recruiting-Vorerfahrung ist ein Plus, kein Muss – das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei.
So geht's weiter
1. Bewerben in 2 Minuten – ohne Anschreiben, Lebenslauf genügt.
2. Kurzes Kennenlern-Telefonat – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.
3. Persönliches Gespräch in unserem Office in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Nimm deinen Erfolg JETZT selbst in die Hand – wir freuen uns auf dich!

Talent Acquisition Partner – Field Sales
🕐 Fixed-term (1-year) contract · Full-time
About SumUp
We believe in the everyday hero — those who have the courage to follow their passion and the determination to realise their dreams.
Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their businesses. With a founder's mentality and a team-first attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America, and the United States work together to ensure that small business owners can be successful doing what they love.

You'll join our Global Talent Acquisition team, dedicated to finding and empowering the best talent across SumUp. This role will focus on the Sales hiring stream, one of the fastest-growing and most business-critical areas at SumUp.
As a Senior TA professional, you'll work day-to-day with Sales leaders across Europe and help strengthen how we hire through process, data, stakeholder coaching, and disciplined execution. Depending on your experience and team needs, you will take part in leading initiatives and mentoring other TA team members.
You'll be based in one of our main hubs, Berlin and collaborate closely with colleagues across multiple European markets.

Own the end-to-end recruitment process for Field Sales roles across primarily Germany and other European markets.
Partner with Sales leaders to define scorecards, interview loops, and SLAs, ensuring Act as a trusted advisor to Sales leaders: clarify priorities, sense-check asks, and drive alignment on what "good" looks like.
Build and run structured hiring: scorecards, calibrated interview loops, interviewer guidance, and consistent decision-making.
Create persona-based sourcing and attraction plans, partnering with Employer Branding when needed.
Run weekly funnel and pipeline reviews, turning data into decisions
Identify systemic bottlenecks and drive improvements that raise hiring quality, speed, and candidate experience.
Bring strong offer and closing partnership: manage trade-offs, expectations, and decision-making to land hires effectively.
Maintain process discipline and ensure hiring practices remain compliant, fair, and consistent across markets.
You'll Be Great for This Role If You
Have strong experience owning Sales hiring in a fast-paced environment; you can manage complexity across multiple markets.
Are excellent at influencing senior stakeholders; you can challenge unrealistic or low-value requests constructively, without becoming a blocker.
Have a track record with structured hiring (scorecards, evidence-based assessment, calibrated decision-making).
Use data naturally to run your desk: you're fluent in funnel metrics, trade-offs, forecasting.
Combine hands-on execution with a system mindset: you improve the machine while running the process.
Communicate with clarity and pace, and you create trust through follow-through and high standards.
Fluency in English and German is a must, an additional European language is a plus (e.g. French, Italian, Portuguese or Spanish).
Why You Should Join SumUp
🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education
🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses around the world with simple, affordable tools to help them start, run, and grow. More than 4 million merchants across 36 markets trust us as their financial partner — and we're just getting started.
We're a global team of 3,000+ people from over 90 nationalities, united by curiosity, collaboration, and care. Our core values and culture shape everything we do, fostering inclusion, learning, and belonging.
SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, committed to building a safe, respectful, and diverse workplace where everyone can thrive.
👉 Explore more about our culture on our careers site , or follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram .

You don't need a perfect CV. You need the right skills.
This is not a role that filters by job title or tenure. It filters by what you can actually do.
We are looking for a recruiter who owns the full process — from the first Boolean search string to the signed offer, without
hand-holding, without process gaps, and without needing someone to define the search for them.
Skills are the filter, not biography. If you can demonstrate the capabilities below, we want to hear from you, regardless of how
your career path looks on paper.

You will be the driving force behind talent acquisition at a fast-growing, AI-powered HR Tech startup based in Berlin. This is an
internal recruiting role, not a staffing agency seat, not a volume-first environment.
You will own the complete hiring funnel: sharpen the role before searching, build and execute sourcing strategies, conduct
structured interviews, and manage stakeholders who need to be challenged, not just served.
Roles are thought of in terms of skill requirements, not job titles. The result is precision instead of volume. That's the standard
you'll work within and the standard you'll be held to.

A coordinator position waiting for candidates to come in
A reactive sourcing seat with no strategic mandate
A bureaucratic HR function with fixed playbooks and no autonomy

Full ownership of the recruiting process from identification to signed offer
A strategic partner seat, you challenge requirements, you advise, you deliver
A skill-first environment where your process quality matters more than your job title history
Your Skill Map
Core Skills are the central, non-negotiable capabilities of the role. Extended Skills are desirable additional competencies that
strengthen the profile but are not a knockout criterion.
Core Skills - KO Level
These are non-negotiable. If you cannot demonstrate these, this role is not a match.
Full-Cycle Recruiting Ownership
You independently drive the complete hiring process, from role clarification and sourcing strategy through structured
assessment to offer and close — without process gaps or handoffs mid-funnel.
What we look for: You can describe a search you ran end-to-end, including how you aligned the hiring manager on
requirements before searching, how you structured the funnel, and how you navigated blockers.
Active Sourcing via LinkedIn Recruiter
You can build and execute complex Boolean search strings from scratch, not just apply standard filters. You understand
how to construct multi-layer queries, use operators, and adapt strings to market signals.
What we look for: You can write a Boolean string for a target role live, explain the logic behind it, and describe how you would
adapt it if initial results are too narrow or too broad.
Competency-Based Interviewing
You conduct structured interviews using a defined competency framework. Your candidate assessments are evidencebased, documented, and defensible, not impressionistic.
What we look for: You can explain how you assess a specific competency in an interview, what question structure you use, and
how you document the evidence. You distinguish between self-reported claims and demonstrated behavior.
Stakeholder Advisory
You challenge hiring managers when role definitions are unrealistic, market expectations are off, or process decisions
create risk. You align before searching, not after.
What we look for: You can describe a situation where you pushed back on a hiring manager's position and explain how you
built the case and navigated the outcome.
Data-Driven Recruiting
You read, interpret, and act on funnel KPIs, time-to-hire, source-to-screen conversion, offer acceptance rates. You use
data to make process decisions, not just report them.
What we look for: You can describe a recruiting funnel metric you tracked, how you interpreted it, and what process change it
drove.
Language Skills — Non-Negotiable
German at C2 / native-equivalent level, required for candidate conversations, stakeholder communication, and process
documentation in a German-speaking context. English at C1+ level, required for written and verbal communication in an
international team environment.
AGG note: Both language requirements are professionally justified by the candidate-facing and client-facing nature of the role
Strong Skills - Valued, Not KO
These strengthen your application but will not exclude you if absent.
Talent Pool Architecture: You systematically build, segment, and maintain candidate pipelines for recurring roles, not ad hoc lists
AI & Tech Tool Affinity: You have hands-on experience with modern ATS systems and AI-assisted sourcing or matching tools
Employer Branding Contribution: You can co-create job ad copy, LinkedIn content, or employer brand messaging, not just distribute it
Startup / Scale-Up Navigation: You have delivered results in environments where process, structure, and resources were all still being built
What You'll Work With
AI-powered recruiting infrastructure: The team you'll join builds and operates its own recruiting tooling. You will use it daily.
Modern ATS environment: Structured pipelines, documented stages, KPI tracking built in
LinkedIn Recruiter: Including Recruiter Lite or full seat, depending on search volume
Direct collaboration with a small, senior team, no layers, short decision paths
A technology-first environment where manual workarounds are the exception, not the norm
The operating model follows a clear sequence: first understand, then structure, then automate. Everyone working here works not in individual cases, but within a system.
What's On Offer
Hybrid working model: Berlin base, flexible execution
Real ownership: You design and run your own processes within a clear framework, no micromanagement
Direct access to decision-makers: No approval chains for sourcing decisions or outreach copy
Growth context: You are part of building the internal recruiting capability, not maintaining a legacy setup
Purpose-driven work: Recruiting done properly: structured, skill-based, documented, and fair
Compensation: Salary is discussed transparently during the process, benchmarked against market data. No blanket figures
without basis. If this is relevant for you upfront, mention it in your application, we'll address it directly.
Our Hiring Process
We screen based on skills, not credentials. Here is what to expect:
Application review: A person reads every application, no automated filtering
Short intro call (20–30 min): Context, fit, mutual questions
Skills-based interview (60 min): Structured, competency-specific, with documented assessment
Optional: work sample or personality test: Role-relevant, time-boxed, focused on a real scenario
Final conversation + decision: Transparent feedback regardless of outcome
We aim to respond within 5 business days. If timelines shift, we communicate proactively.

Du weißt, wie Recruiting wirklich funktioniert. Wir bauen die Infrastruktur dafür.
Bei selectry suchen wir nicht einfach jemanden, der Stellen besetzt. Wir suchen jemanden, der Recruiting als strategische
Disziplin versteht und Lust hat, das in einem Umfeld zu leben, in dem AI-Technologie und menschliche Recruiting-Expertise
Hand in Hand gehen.
Über uns
selectry ist ein AI-powered HR Tech Startup mit Sitz in Berlin. Wir helfen Unternehmen, die richtigen Talente schneller zu finden durch intelligente Automatisierung, strukturierte Prozesse und ein Candidate-Matching-System, das funktioniert.
Was uns unterscheidet: Wir bauen nicht nur Recruiting-Prozesse. Wir automatisieren sie mit KI-Agenten, die den gesamten
Funnel abdecken. Vom Intake über die Suchstrategie bis zur Vorqualifikation. Du arbeitest bei uns nicht trotz Technologie,
sondern mit ihr.
Unser Team ist klein, fokussiert und wächst bewusst. Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Eigenverantwortung und echte Mitgestaltungsmöglichkeiten.
Deine Aufgaben
Full-Cycle Recruiting: Du steuerst den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess eigenverantwortlich, von der ersten Identifikation geeigneter Kandidat:innen bis zur Vertragsunterzeichnung
Active Sourcing: Du nutzt LinkedIn Recruiter und weitere Kanäle für gezielte, personalisierte Direktansprache und du weißt, wie man komplexe Suchstrategien entwickelt und umsetzt
Talentpool-Aufbau: Du denkst über die aktuelle Stelle hinaus und baust nachhaltige Talentpools auf, die langfristig Wert liefern
Kompetenzbasierte Interviews: Du führst strukturierte Interviews nach Kompetenzmodellen und bewertest Kandidat:innen fundiert und nachvollziehbar
KPI-gesteuertes Recruiting: Du analysierst relevante Recruiting-Kennzahlen, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und setzt Maßnahmen um
Candidate Experience: Du sorgst dafür, dass jede Interaktion mit selectry als Arbeitgeber einen positiven Eindruck hinterlässt – von der ersten Ansprache bis zur Entscheidung
Hiring-Manager-Beratung: Du berätst interne Stakeholder zu Anforderungsprofilen, Marktlage und Recruiting-Strategie auf Augenhöhe, nicht als Dienstleister
Employer Branding: Du bringst dich aktiv in Recruiting- und Employer-Branding-Projekte ein und mitgestaltest, wie selectry als Arbeitgebermarke wahrgenommen wird
Dein Profil

· Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Recruiting – idealerweise mit Fokus auf Sales Recruiting, Executive Search oder
anspruchsvolle Fach- und Führungspositionen

· Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Active Sourcing und der Entwicklung komplexer Suchstrategien (Boolean, LinkedIn, MultiChannel)

· Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Steuerung des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses von A bis Z

· Sicherer Umgang mit modernen Recruiting-Tools (ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter, ggf. AI-gestützte Tools)

· Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenz – du berätst Hiring Manager souverän und vertrittst
Recruiting-Entscheidungen mit Substanz

· Strukturierte, datenorientierte Arbeitsweise – du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen, nicht nur Bauchgefühl

· Deutsch auf C2-Niveau (KO-Kriterium)

· Englisch auf mindestens C1-Niveau (KO-Kriterium)

· Erfahrung in einem Startup- oder Scale-up-Umfeld

· Affinität zu AI-gestützten Recruiting-Prozessen und HR Tech

· Erfahrung im Aufbau von Talentpools und Candidate-Relationship-Management
Was wir bieten

· Eigenverantwortung von Tag 1: Kein Mikromanagement, keine langen Freigabeprozesse – du gestaltest deinen Bereich
aktiv mit

· AI-first Recruiting-Umfeld: Arbeite mit modernsten Recruiting-Tools und KI-Agenten, die dir wirklich Arbeit abnehmen

· Mitgestaltung: Als einer der ersten Recruiting-Profis im Team baust du mit auf – Prozesse, Strukturen, Employer Branding

· Hybrides Arbeiten mit Büro in Berlin und flexibler Remote-Option

· Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

· Entwicklungsperspektive in einem wachsenden Startup mit echter Mission

· Weiterbildungsbudget und Zugang zu modernen HR-Tech-Tools

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.
Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.
Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

Chainguard is securing the open source software supply chain, the infrastructure every modern engineering team depends on. We're growing fast, and how we hire technical talent will define the shape of our engineering and product organizations for years to come.

We're looking for a Technical Recruiting Manager who can raise the bar on technical hiring, build the infrastructure that doesn't exist yet, and operate as a genuine thought partner to our CPO, Head of Engineering, and CISO. If you've watched an engineering org double in size and know exactly what breaks at that inflection point, this is your role.

Lead and develop a team of technical recruiters: coach for quality over throughput, hold a high bar on technical screening and debrief quality, and invest in each person's growth, including those who are already strong.
Partner directly with engineering and product leadership: build trusted working relationships with our CPO, Head of Engineering, and Head of Security; push back constructively when you disagree; bring data and honest assessments to every conversation.
Standardize technical interviewer training: build a program that's practical and low-lift for interviewers and tied to real calibration outcomes for the engineers who interview frequently at Chainguard.
Own recruiting strategy across engineering, product, and security: set sourcing strategy, hiring timelines, and quality thresholds for your function; know when a req needs a different approach and have the credibility to drive that conversation.
Manage a high-volume, high-complexity pipeline: keep your team focused, unblocked, and making good decisions in an environment where priorities shift, and the quality bar is high.

8+ years in technical recruiting, including at least 2 years managing a team, you've supported an engineering org through significant scale and know what had to be built at each stage.
An independent, developed point of view on what strong engineering and PM talent looks like, you can coach your recruiters to hold that same bar and have a credible conversation with a skeptical engineering leader about what recruiting can actually improve.
Infrastructure builder, not just a process runner, you've stood up at least one of the following from scratch: interview committees, interviewer training programs, or calibration frameworks.
Stakeholder credibility, you push back when you're right, bring data when you disagree, and build trust with leaders who have high standards.
Strong team developer, you know how to coach high-performing ICs to get stronger and manage through performance issues without letting them drag the team.
Closer and seller, you know how to position Chainguard against a late-stage pre-IPO, a FAANG team, and an early-stage startup, and you've closed candidates who had better-known options.

I believe that great recruiting is about much more than filling vacancies. It's about becoming a trusted recruiting partner , helping companies build strong teams, improve their hiring processes and make better hiring decisions.
Since 2021, I have been, with my company Hugo Schenk UG (haftungsbeschränkt) , building long-term partnerships with clients ranging from innovative start-ups and growing SMEs to established international businesses . These companies operate across a variety of sectors, including software and digital solutions, industrial technology, electronics manufacturing, e-mobility and retail.
I believe in working as an integrated recruiting partner, becoming part of each client's team to develop a deep understanding of its business, culture and hiring needs . This hands-on, collaborative approach enables tailored recruiting solutions that create lasting value for clients.
As the company continues to grow, I am looking for a freelance Tech Recruiter (m/f/d) who shares this philosophy and enjoys taking ownership of recruiting projects while building long-term relationships with clients.
This role can be performed from anywhere within the European Union.
Tasks
Take ownership of the complete end-to-end recruitment process for technical and business roles.
Become a trusted recruiting partner for clients by developing a deep understanding of their business, culture, teams and hiring needs.
Advise clients on recruiting strategies, sourcing approaches, hiring processes and market trends to help them attract and hire the right talent.
Identify and engage suitable candidates through active sourcing and professional networks.
Conduct professional interviews and present shortlisted candidates together with your assessment and recommendation.

For us, your personality, ambition and joy in dealing with people matter.

You build sustainable relationships and actively contribute to the growth of our company.
With us, you are not just employed. You are an important part of our team.

* New client acquisition You actively acquire new clients, convince companies of our services and continuously expand your own client portfolio.
* Client care You personally look after existing clients, identify their personnel needs and develop suitable solutions.
* Consulting You support companies in their personnel search and assist candidates in their next career step.
* Network building You maintain long-term relationships with companies, candidates and business partners and continuously expand your personal network.
* Organisation & administration You coordinate the entire placement process - from job posting through candidate selection to successful placement and support during the assignment.

* Good to very good French skills

* Varied working day No day is like the other. You work with different companies, industries and personalities and take on varied tasks in sales, consulting, recruiting and support.
* Free drinks Coffee, tea, mineral water and soft drinks are available to you free of charge at any time.

People achieve great things when they feel comfortable, are allowed to take responsibility and their work is appreciated. That is exactly what selected ag stands for.

Tu piloteras des missions de recrutement de bout en bout pour des profils experts, cadres et dirigeants évoluant au sein du secteur de la transition énergétique. Tu évolueras dans un environnement structuré, rythmé par des objectifs clairs te permettant d'organiser efficacement ton activité. En parallèle, tu développeras ton portefeuille de clients en toute autonomie et contribueras activement à la croissance et au rayonnement de cette nouvelle entité stratégique.
Tu veux être au coeur de la transition énergétique en recrutant les leaders qui construiront le monde de demain?
Tu développes, fidélises et accompagnes un portefeuille de clients, en les conseillant sur leurs enjeux de recrutement et de croissance, notamment dans le domaine de la transition énergétique.
Tu analyses les besoins de tes clients en profondeur et élabores des stratégies de recherche sur mesure, combinant approche directe, chasse de tête et méthodes de sourcing ciblées.
Tu construis et entretiens un réseau solide de candidats qualifiés, tout en développant une expertise approfondie de ton marché et de ses évolutions.
Tu identifies, approches et attires des profils à forte valeur ajoutée grâce à une démarche proactive et à des techniques de sourcing avancées.
Tu évalues les candidats au travers d'entretiens approfondis et d'outils d'évaluation structurés, puis présentes à tes clients des sélections pertinentes, argumentées et alignées avec leurs besoins.
Véritable partenaire stratégique, tu conseilles et accompagnes tes clients tout au long du processus de recrutement, de la définition du besoin jusqu'à la prise de décision.
Tu pilotes l'ensemble des mandats qui te sont confiés, en garantissant une expérience de qualité pour l'ensemble des parties prenantes.
Tu prépares et accompagnes les candidats dans leurs démarches, en les aidant à valoriser leur parcours et à maximiser leurs chances de réussite sur des fonctions clés.
Tu facilites les phases de négociation entre candidats et clients et contribues à la conclusion réussie des recrutements.
Tu assures un suivi rigoureux des missions, des candidats et des clients jusqu'à l'intégration des talents et durant leur période d'essai.
Tu participes activement au développement de la notoriété et de la crédibilité de notre nouvelle entité en représentant l'entreprise lors d'événements, en développant ton réseau et en partageant ton expertise sectorielle.
Tu es titulaire d'un diplôme de l'enseignement supérieur (université, haute école ou formation équivalente).
Tu bénéficies d'une expérience confirmée, idéalement de cinq ans ou plus, dans le recrutement, la chasse de tête ou le conseil, et possèdes une bonne connaissance du marché suisse.
Tu maîtrises parfaitement le français et disposes d'un excellent niveau professionnel en anglais. La maîtrise de l'allemand constitue un atout supplémentaire.
Doté-e d'un fort tempérament commercial, tu sais développer, entretenir et pérenniser des relations de confiance avec des interlocuteurs de haut niveau.
Tu es reconnu-e pour ton autonomie, ton sens de l'organisation et ton orientation résultats, ainsi que pour ta capacité à piloter des mandats complexes avec rigueur et efficacité.
Tu fais preuve d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et comprends rapidement les enjeux stratégiques, organisationnels et humains de tes clients.
Tu manifestes un intérêt marqué pour les environnements techniques et es sensible aux défis et aux opportunités liés à la transition énergétique.
Tu te distingues par ton sens du conseil, ta crédibilité et ton aptitude à accompagner aussi bien les clients que les candidats dans leurs prises de décision stratégiques.
Tu rejoins une équipe expérimentée et reconnue pour son expertise, son exigence de qualité et sa contribution concrète aux enjeux de la transition énergétique.
Tu évolues au sein d'une structure portée par une mission à fort impact, accompagnant les acteurs qui façonnent l'avenir du secteur de l'énergie.
Tu travailles dans des bureaux idéalement situés en centre-ville, offrant un environnement propice à la collaboration, aux échanges et à l'innovation. Le télétravail fait pleinement partie de notre mode de fonctionnement.
Tu bénéficies d'un cadre de travail flexible et stimulant, favorisant l'autonomie, l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle, ainsi que le développement de relations fortes au sein de l'équipe.
Tu profites de conditions de rémunération attractives, associant un salaire fixe compétitif à un système de rémunération variable directement lié à ta performance et à ta contribution au développement de l'activité.
Tu participes à la construction et à la croissance d'une nouvelle entité ambitieuse, avec l'opportunité d'avoir un impact réel sur sa stratégie, son développement et son positionnement sur le marché.

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.
Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery.

The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.
At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.
Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas—including airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special mission aviation, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation.

Whenever we operate, we build vertically integrated full stacks of capability—designing, building, and operating turnkey solutions that let customers scale capacity while benefiting from continuous cycles of innovation. With operators and engineers under one roof, we close the gap between lab and field—what we call connecting design with effect.

Metrea’s solutions are built for elegance: effective, efficient, and evolving. This approach enables our partners to do more with less and achieve outsized, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. Headquartered in Washington, DC, Metrea has facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and beyond.

At Metrea, we seek out the most demanding national security challenges and proactively develop elegant solutions – those solutions start with our people, and their ability to deliver mission-critical effects around the world.

The demand for home renovations has never been stronger, yet, it's surprisingly difficult for a new homeowner to renovate. It can take a decade to build up enough home equity and savings to pay for a major renovation. As a result, recent homeowners do a lot of financially-suboptimal things to compensate like borrow from their 401k, rack up credit card debt, and use high-interest personal loans. Or they just live unhappily for years in a home that doesn't meet their family's needs.
But by completing a major renovation, homeowners are increasing the value of their home. Professional real estate investors leverage this After Renovation Value (ARV) to roll the increase in value into new properties all the time. But there hasn't been a great way for homeowners to take advantage of this. If homeowners had an ability to borrow against the ARV, they could increase their borrowing power up to 10x.
To meet this need, RenoFi created a platform that enables homeowners to borrow funds from RenoFi approved lenders in the form of the first home equity loan purpose-built for renovations! Unlike standard home equity loans, RenoFi Loans use the value of your home post-renovation which lets you borrow the most money at the best possible terms. RenoFi is creating a full suite of renovation loan products to better suit the needs of today’s homeowners!
For homeowners, RenoFi makes it possible to renovate years earlier than might be otherwise feasible. For contractors, we empower the financing of renovations at the point of sale, reducing instances of scope reduction, and ensuring prompt payment.

Our lender partners, most often credit unions, rely on RenoFi's platform to generate loans, create efficiencies, and grow membership. The lenders pay RenoFi for the new loans, which allows us to offer our services to homeowners for free. RenoFi is truly a win-win-win for everyone involved.
RenoFi is backed by some of the best startup investors in the world, including First Round Capital, Comcast Ventures, and Canaan Partners.

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.
We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.
Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.
Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.
Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.
Role Roadmap
Kalshi’s next stage of growth depends on hiring exceptional people who can bring prediction markets to a much larger audience. We’re looking for a Marketing & Growth Recruiter to help build the teams responsible for making that happen.
You’ll own recruiting across growth, marketing, brand, creative, communications, and partnerships. Drive timely feedback, maintain clear next steps, resolve bottlenecks, and give candidates a responsive, well-run experience.
Build relationships, understand candidate motivations, tell Kalshi’s story, and partner with hiring managers to bring offers across the finish line.
Track pipeline health, conversion, speed, and offer acceptance to understand where searches need attention and make changes quickly.

You’ve successfully recruited across several relevant disciplines and can speak credibly with both candidates and hiring managers.
You know how to build a search from scratch, reach passive candidates, and uncover talent beyond the obvious companies and titles.
